synonyms: The Outcast Swordsman, Drawn to Power, Masters the Hidden Dungeon: Once Branded a Monster, the Former Adventurer Dominates in a Labyrinth Known Only to Him
synopsis: Jin is an adventurer so overwhelmingly strong that he can cut down a three-headed dragon with a single slash! Though he craves more power, he fears that becoming any stronger would turn him into a monster... so he retires from adventuring and returns to his hometown café, in Dagar! However, in the mountains behind his family home lies a dungeon said to grant one’s deepest desires...?! Together with Shuna, a runaway saint who suddenly barges into his life, the power-hungry former adventurer sets out to conquer the dangerous, monster-filled dungeon! And after the battles, they savor exquisite dungeon cuisine made from the monsters they defeat—?!

I Hate That We're Childhood Friends!: My Rise to the Top of School Life with an S-Rank Beauty Begins After a Falling Out
synopsis: Kazuma Suzuki was just your average high schooler—until his childhood friend, Rua Takayashiki, a beautiful, sharp-tongued girl who also happened to be the granddaughter of the school chairman and the nation’s top idol, cut all ties with him using a line straight out of a drama. Forced into submission for years as her so-called childhood friend, Kazuma decides it’s finally time for his first-ever rebellion. He’s done playing lapdog. This time, he’s taking back his freedom—and aiming for a normal school life. Escaping a powerful beauty like her is easier said than done... (Source: Square Enix)

title: Eko Eko Azaraku
synopsis: When the chant "Eko Eko Azarak" sounds something is bound to occur, be it within the town or the school! A classic horror manga, Eko Eko Azarak follows the witch Misa Kuroi ("Black Mass" in Japanese), and the various horrors she encounters during her travels. While relatively unknown outside of Japan the series was extremely well received domestically. It lasted for 19 volumes, spawned two sequels, an OVA, two TV series, six live action films and two video games. Included one-shot: Volume 19: Hitokui Ichizoku

title: KaguRai: Kagura to Raito
synopsis: Kagura is a samurai girl known as the "Sword Saint" for her mastery of the way of the sword. And Raito is a boy who belongs to a race called "Hito-youkai" that is hated by the people. The two met in their childhood and spent happy times together as best friends. Until the difference in their races separated them. Kagura took up the sword for Raito. To "live together" in order to do so, the bond between the two that transcends years transcends walls, races, and reality!! A one-shot story in the Sunday magazine received such a great response that it has been decided to serialize it! A Japanese-Western mixed fantasy with overwhelming brushwork that will rush out into the world! The start of this story!! (Source: Sunday Webry, translated)
